partners.sub: Businesses that resell DripFunnel, including DripFunnel itself. Invite only: a partner exists only when staff create it.

noMatch.body: Try another search, or clear the filters to see every partner.

empty.title: No partners yet
empty.body: Partners are invite only. Create the first one: it starts as a draft, and you choose when its owner is invited.

error.title: We couldn’t load partners
error.body: The admin service didn’t answer in time. Nothing was changed.

readOnly.title: You have read-only access
readOnly.body: You can see every partner, but you can’t change anything. Ask a Super admin if you need to.

refusals.PARTNER_ADMINS_ONLY: Only a Super admin or Partner manager can {verb}.
refusals.INVITERS_ONLY: Only a Super admin, Partner manager or Support can {verb}.
refusals.HOUSE_PARTNER: {name} is the house partner and can’t be paused.

partner.pausedNote: No new merchant signups. Existing stores keep running.

notFound.title: We can’t find that partner
notFound.body: There’s no partner with that link on this platform.

error.title: We couldn’t load this partner
error.body: The admin service didn’t answer in time. Nothing was changed.

partner.readOnlyEdited: Read-only. Edited in the partner console, by the partner or by you through Set up for partner.

domains.note: Read-only. The partner points these at DripFunnel from their DNS provider. Checked every 10 minutes.

rechecked.waiting: Checked just now: {host} is still waiting for DNS.
rechecked.failed: Checked just now: {host} still points somewhere else.

domains.none: No domains yet. The partner adds them in their own console.

team.invitationSub: Partners are invite only. The owner joins through this invitation.

invitationDetail.sent: Sent {date} to {email}. The link works until they accept, or until you resend it.
invitationDetail.held: Not sent yet. Send it when the setup is ready; {org}’s owner will see what’s been done.

team.nobody: No one has joined yet. The owner joins when they accept the invitation.
team.houseTeam: DripFunnel’s own team are staff, and staff can’t be impersonated.

placeholders.stores: This partner’s stores appear here once the Stores list is built.
placeholders.activity: Audit entries about this partner appear here once the Activity log is built.

approve.title: Approve {name}?
approve.consequence: Merchants can sign up at {host} from now on.
approve.reasonHint: Kept in the activity log, e.g. “Contract signed 24 Sep, KYC passed”.

sendBack.title: Send {name} back?
sendBack.consequence: {name} goes back to Draft with your reason.
sendBack.reasonHint: Shown to the partner in their console.

pause.title: Pause {name}?
pause.consequence: No new merchant signups. Its {count} stores keep running.
notes: Only {name} is affected. No other partner changes.

setupSession.title: Set up {name}?
setupSession.consequence: Opens {name}’s partner console for you for 2 hours. You can do its whole setup and submit it for approval. Its payment and payout details stay with {name}.
notes: You’ll be asked to sign in again before it opens.
Everything you save is logged as you, tagged “Setup session”.
setupSession.reasonHint: Kept in the activity log, e.g. “Ticket #48213”.

sendInvite.title: Send owner invitation?
sendInvite.consequence: Sends {name}’s owner their invitation. They’ll see the setup you’ve done.

resendInvite.title: Resend owner invitation?
resendInvite.consequence: A new link is sent; the old one stops working.

toasts.approve: {name} is live. Merchants can sign up at {host}.
toasts.setupSession: Setup session requested for {name}. It opens once the Admin API is connected.
toasts.failed: That didn’t go through. Nothing was changed; try again.

signIn.footer: For DripFunnel staff with a company Microsoft account. There is no sign-up and no password here.

start.title: Sign in to the admin console
start.body: Use your DripFunnel Microsoft work account.

signing.title: Signing you in…
signing.body: Waiting for Microsoft to confirm your account.

approve.title: Approve the sign-in
approve.body: We sent a request to Microsoft Authenticator on your phone.
approve.tapNumber: Tap this number in Microsoft Authenticator
approve.waiting: Waiting for you to approve on your phone…
approve.useCode: I can't use my phone — use a code

code.title: Approve the sign-in
code.body: Open Microsoft Authenticator and enter the 6-digit code shown for your DripFunnel account.
code.codeHint: Verify and sign in turns on once all 6 digits are in.
code.sendToPhone: Send the request to my phone instead

cancelled.title: Sign-in was cancelled
cancelled.body: The Microsoft window was closed before you finished. Nothing was changed.
cancelled.detail: You can start again whenever you're ready.

denied.title: The request was denied
denied.body: Someone tapped Deny on the Authenticator request. If that wasn't you, tell IT security now — your password may be known.
denied.detail: For safety we won't send another request for 1 minute.

unavailable.title: Microsoft isn't answering
unavailable.body: We couldn't reach Microsoft to confirm who you are. This is usually brief.
unavailable.detail: Microsoft Entra ID timed out after 20 seconds. Check status.office.com if it keeps happening.

blocked.title: This device can't open the console
blocked.body: Your company only allows the admin console on managed devices. Use your work laptop, or ask IT to enrol this one.
blocked.detail: Blocked by your company's Conditional Access policy · device not compliant.

refused.title: You can't sign in here
refused.body: This account doesn't have access to the admin console. If you think it should, ask a Super admin.

expired.title: Your session expired
expired.body: You were signed out to keep the console safe. Sign in again to carry on; you'll come back to this page.

gallery.title: Screen states
gallery.intro: Every state a screen can show, without an API. Add ?state= to any screen's address to see it in one state.

empty.title: No partners yet
empty.body: Partners are the companies that resell DripFunnel under their own brand. Create the first one and invite its owner.

error.title: We couldn't load the partners
error.body: The admin API didn't answer. Nothing you entered was lost. Try again in a moment.

denied.reason: Only a Super admin can pause a partner.

readonly.title: You have read-only access
readonly.body: Your role can see everything here but can't change anything. Ask a Super admin if you need to.

confirm.title: Close this partner?
confirm.consequence: Closes Northstar Commerce. Its portal host store.northstar.com stops working.
notes: Its 86 stores stop being reachable on that host.
confirm.reasonHint: Required. Close partner turns on once you give a reason.
confirm.typeHint: Type the partner name exactly to confirm.

filters.label: Filter stores
filters.searchPlaceholder: Search name, code, domain or owner email

empty.title: No stores yet
empty.body: Stores appear here when merchants sign up on a partner's portal.

noMatch.title: No stores match
noMatch.body: Try another search, or clear the filters.

error.title: Stores didn't load
error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your filters are kept.

readOnly.title: You can look, not change
readOnly.body: Your role is read-only, so every action here is turned off.

refusals.SUSPENDERS_ONLY: Only a Super admin or the Engineer on call can {verb}.
refusals.RETRIERS_ONLY: Only a Super admin, Support or the Engineer on call can {verb}.
refusals.CLEANERS_ONLY: Only a Super admin or the Engineer on call can {verb}.

refusals.NOTERS_ONLY: Only a Super admin, Partner manager, Support or the Engineer on call can {verb}.

notFound.title: Store not found
notFound.body: It may have been cleaned up after a failed signup, or the link is wrong.

error.title: This store didn't load
error.body: Something went wrong on our side.

overview.name: Name
overview.seeInside: Staff don’t see this store’s catalogue or orders here. To see inside, impersonate one of its users from the Users tab.

provisioning.title: Signup steps

support.title: Support access
support.sub: Set by the merchant in their portal. Staff can’t change it.
support.off: Off · merchant turned support access off

activity.placeholder: The store's activity log arrives with the activity log card.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.sub: Staff only · never shown to the partner or merchant
notes.label: New internal note
notes.placeholder: Add a note for other DripFunnel staff

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.consequence: {name} can’t make changes and its storefront shows a notice.
notes: Only this store is affected. Other {partner} stores keep running.
The owner is told to contact {partner} support.
suspend.emergency: Engineer on call: emergency suspensions are reviewed by a Super admin.
suspend.typeHint: Type the store name exactly to confirm.

restore.title: Restore {name}?
notes: The owner can make changes again and the notice comes off the storefront.

extendTrial.title: Extend the trial of {name}?
extendTrial.tooEarly: Pick a date after the current end, {date}.

retry.title: Retry setup for {name}?
notes: Attempt {next}. Steps that finished are kept.

undo.title: Undo and clean up {name}?
undo.consequence: Removes everything setup made for {name} (store, hostnames, repo) so {owner} can sign up again.
undo.typeHint: Type the store code exactly to confirm.

resendInvite.title: Resend owner invitation?
resendInvite.consequence: A new link is sent to {email}.

toasts.undo: {name} is cleaned up. The merchant can sign up again.
toasts.failed: That didn't work. Nothing was changed. Try again.
